about: Get a single-entry visa to look for a job in the UAE for 60 days, without a UAE host.
aliases: Look for a job UAE visa
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Job exploration visa, 60 days. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Skilled worker at MOHRE levels 1 to 3, or a graduate within the last 2 years of a top-500 world university
Entry visa is valid 60 days from issue; enter within that time or it is cancelled
Passport valid for at least 6 months
Financial guarantee is refundable after the visa is cancelled following departure with no residency violations
documents: MOHRE certificate of skilled category and level, or Ministry of Education certificate of the university's top-500 ranking
Copy of personal ID for applicants from Afghanistan, Iran or Iraq
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
